LGT Capital Partners LTD. Grows Holdings in Apple (AAPL) Posted by Alanna Baker | Apr 16th, 2018 
LGT Capital Partners LTD. grew its stake in Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 3.0% in the fourth quarter, according to the company in its most recent Form 13F filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission. The institutional investor owned 22,990 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after buying an additional 670 shares during the quarter. LGT Capital Partners LTD.’s holdings in Apple were worth $3,891,000 as of its most recent SEC filing. 
Other institutional investors and hedge funds also recently modified their holdings of the company. Cardan Capital Partners LLC grew its position in shares of Apple by 2.5% during the fourth quarter. Cardan Capital Partners LLC now owns 16,880 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $2,856,000 after purchasing an additional 414 shares in the last quarter. Windward Capital Management Co. CA grew its position in shares of Apple by 0.7% during the fourth quarter. Windward Capital Management Co. CA now owns 322,932 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $54,649,000 after purchasing an additional 2,132 shares in the last quarter. Bogart Wealth LLC grew its position in shares of Apple by 31.5% during the fourth quarter. Bogart Wealth LLC now owns 6,153 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $1,041,000 after purchasing an additional 1,474 shares in the last quarter. Grubman Wealth Management grew its position in shares of Apple by 168.0% during the fourth quarter. Grubman Wealth Management now owns 5,740 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $971,000 after purchasing an additional 3,598 shares in the last quarter. Finally, Patriot Wealth Management Inc. grew its position in shares of Apple by 12.5% during the fourth quarter. Patriot Wealth Management Inc. now owns 113,150 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $19,148,000 after purchasing an additional 12,533 shares in the last quarter. Institutional investors and hedge funds own 61.35% of the company’s stock. 
AAPL has been the subject of several research analyst reports. UBS set a $190.00 target price on Apple and gave the stock a “buy” rating in a research report on Friday, January 5th. Morgan Stanley reissued a “buy” rating and set a $205.00 price target (up from $200.00) on shares of Apple in a research note on Tuesday, January 23rd. Sanford C. Bernstein lowered Apple from an “outperform” rating to a “market perform” rating and dropped their price target for the company from $195.00 to $170.00 in a research note on Friday, February 2nd. HSBC set a $204.00 price target on Apple and gave the company a “buy” rating in a research note on Tuesday, January 30th. Finally, Vetr raised Apple from a “hold” rating to a “buy” rating and set a $184.49 price target for the company in a research note on Monday, March 5th. Two research analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, seventeen have issued a hold rating, thirty-two have given a buy rating and one has given a strong buy rating to the stock. The stock has a consensus rating of “Buy” and an average price target of $203.21. 
In related news, SVP Daniel J. Riccio sold 17,375 shares of the firm’s stock in a transaction that occurred on Wednesday, April 4th. The stock was sold at an average price of $169.12, for a total transaction of $2,938,460.00. Following the completion of the sale, the senior vice president now directly owns 66,191 shares of the company’s stock, valued at approximately $11,194,221.92. The sale was disclosed in a filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission, which is available through this hyperlink . Also, insider Philip W. Schiller sold 69,491 shares of the firm’s stock in a transaction that occurred on Tuesday, April 3rd. The stock was sold at an average price of $166.42, for a total value of $11,564,692.22. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . Insiders have sold a total of 125,988 shares of company stock valued at $21,336,201 over the last three months. 0.06% of the stock is owned by corporate insiders. 
Shares of AAPL stock traded up $1.09 on Monday, reaching $175.82. 21,546,084 shares of the company’s stock were exchanged, compared to its average volume of 36,323,715. Apple has a 52 week low of $140.45 and a 52 week high of $183.50. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.74, a quick ratio of 1.20 and a current ratio of 1.24. The firm has a market capitalization of $886,582.31, a P/E ratio of 19.09, a P/E/G ratio of 1.32 and a beta of 1.25. 
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last issued its quarterly earnings results on Thursday, February 1st. The iPhone maker reported $3.89 earnings per share (EPS) for the quarter, topping the Zacks’ consensus estimate of $3.82 by $0.07. Apple had a return on equity of 37.37% and a net margin of 21.13%. The firm had revenue of $88.29 billion during the quarter, compared to analyst estimates of $87.62 billion. During the same period last year, the company earned $3.36 EPS. Apple’s quarterly revenue was up 12.7% compared to the same quarter last year. sell-side analysts forecast that Apple will post 11.37 EPS for the current year.

Apple Profile 
Apple Inc (Apple) designs, manufactures and markets mobile communication and media devices, personal computers, and portable digital music players, and a variety of related software, services, peripherals, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications. The Company’s products and services include iPhone, iPad, Mac, iPod, Apple TV, a portfolio of consumer and professional software applications, the iOS and OS X operating systems, iCloud, and a variety of accessory, service and support offerings.
